environmentContract.explicitEmpty: Passes an empty mapping instead of inheriting parent variables
environmentContract.explicitMapping: Copies and validates the entire selected replacement environment; no merge with parent
environmentContract.invalidInput: Fixed path-free refusal before process creation; supplied names and values are not echoed

limitations: This is an optional process interface. Existing preparer calls retain their previous inherited environment until a separately reviewed integration selects a policy.

The caller remains responsible for the executable, absolute path, admitted hashes and allowed variable values. This helper does not admit tools, restrict builtin capabilities or provide network/filesystem isolation.

A harmless local NODE_OPTIONS preload wrote a retained marker in the inherited control. Empty and selected mappings prevented that preload; the retained reserve bundle passed 23 fixtures through the process helper. No real compiler, validator or chain operation was executed.
The Python suite uses local processes and supplied preparation responses. Its success does not replace real genesis compilation, Linux host admission or strict ledger replays.
The 16 MiB process stdin bound and 32 MiB adapter input bound remain distinct; end-to-end payload sizing still needs integration review.
